gameDescriptionHtml:
Enter the wilderness
Either on foot or behind the wheel of your all-terrain vehicle, explore this open world’s stunning environments.

Set off to deepest Colorado, or untamed outback of Texas, each with dozens of wild species to hunt. In these ever-changing ecosystems, each animal reacts to what you do, ages over time, and exhibits true-to-life behaviour thanks to our unique “SimFauna” system.

Hunt your own way
Kit yourself out with one of the official weapons and other items , to hunt the way you want. Choose from a professional hunting arsenal, comprising rifles, shotguns, bows and crossbows. Take your pick from the best hunting brands like, Remington, Beretta, Winchester, Browning and many more.

A hunter’s best friend
To help you in your hunt, you can rely on your faithful hunting dog. With its keen senses, it helps you better understand your surroundings and allows you to spot tracks, follow a trail, or retrieve small game.

Use the command wheel to make it respond to all your orders.

A warm, practical hunting lodge
Feel like a bit of peace and quiet, admiring your arsenal or honing your shooting skills?

Take advantage of your customisable hunting lodge to showcase your finest trophies, purchase or modify your gear, or simply relax by the fire before your next hunt.

Test yourself in an intense clay-pigeon shoot. Armed with your favourite weapon, knock down the targets within the allotted time to score maximum points, and try to reach the top of the leaderboard!
